[Show storage locations](command:sessionkeeper.showStorage)

SessionKeeper reads Claude Code's local session files and keeps a versioned copy in a folder you choose.
cfg.vaultPath: Folder where backups are stored. Leave empty to use the default location for your system. Pick a folder you already back up (external drive, NAS). If you pick a cloud-synced folder, remember transcripts can contain credentials.
cfg.claudeHome: Override the Claude Code configuration folder (defaults to `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, or `~/.claude`).
cfg.includeCodex: Also list and back up Codex sessions (`~/.codex/sessions`). Experimental.
